citations.narrative:
During a review of facility records, the following non-compliance involving lack of guidance on reporting deficiencies in
animal care and treatment was observed. An anonymous complaint was submitted through the reporting system on
January 7, 2026. The complaint alleged that a husbandry technician in the Division of Comparative Medicine (DCM) was
observed mishandling dogs including handling by the scruff, pulling on the leash instead of picking the dog up, and using
a foot to move a dog. The complainant alleged they had reported the incidents previously with no evidence of action being
taken. The technician involved received counseling, training, and disciplinary actions prior to the anonymous complaint
but no reports were made to the IACUC. The IACUC investigation concluded that the DCM failed to communicate with the
IACUC on matters that impact animal welfare as the IACUC was not aware of the issue until the anonymous complaint.
No injuries were reported in the dogs as a result of the handling incidents. The technician was ultimately assigned to a
position not working with dogs.
Failure to ensure personnel receive adequate guidance on methods of reporting deficiencies in animal care and treatment
can result in negative effects on animal welfare.
It is the responsibility of the research facility to ensure that all personnel receive instruction and training including
guidance on methods of reporting deficiencies in animal care and treatment.
Correct by: Corrected at the time of inspection. Continue to ensure adequate guidance on methods of reporting
deficiencies in animal care and treatment from 7/20/26 forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the IACUC representatives.
